title: Finite coefficient expression for tensor cycles with flat cokernel
statement: Let $R\to A\to B$ be a compatible tower of commutative rings and let $X\xrightarrow{d}Y\xrightarrow{q}Z\to0$ be an exact sequence of $R$-modules [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence]. Suppose $A\otimes_R Z$ is flat over $A$ [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]. For every $z\in X\otimes_R B$ satisfying $(d\otimes1)(z)=0$, there exist $n\ge0$, elements $x_i\in X\otimes_R A$ with $(d\otimes1)(x_i)=0$, and $b_i\in B$ such that $z=\sum_{i<n}(1\otimes(b_i\cdot(A\to B)))(x_i)$. The map on coefficients sends $a$ to $b_i\,\operatorname{image}(a)$.

source.place: Tag 00MM, lemma-surjective-on-tor-one, the kernel base-change paragraph (read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/00MM).

proof.text: Tensor the exact pair d,q with A. Mathlib lTensor_exact and lTensor_surjective give dA,qA exact with qA surjective. Set I=range(dA), K=ker(dA), and dI=dA.rangeRestrict. The pairs K.subtype,dI and I.subtype,qA are exact and dI is surjective.

Flatness of A tensor Z and LinearMap.lTensor_injective_of_exact_of_flat make I.subtype.lTensor B injective. Let eX and eY be AlgebraTensorModule.cancelBaseChange. Pure tensor calculations show these equivalences intertwine dA.lTensor B with d.baseChange B. Thus w=eX.symm(comm(z)) is killed by dA.lTensor B, and injectivity implies dI.lTensor B kills w. Tensor right exactness on K → A tensor X → I gives v in B tensor_A K with image w.

Use TensorProduct.exists_finset to write v as a finite sum of pure tensors, indexed by Fin(card S) via Fintype.equivFin. Commute each A tensor X kernel element to obtain x_i in X tensor A. The kernel condition gives the required cycle equations. Applying comm composed with cancelBaseChange to the tensor sum gives the displayed formula; verify the coefficient formula by tensor induction and Algebra.smul_def.

lean.statement:
theorem tensor_cycles_flat_cokernel
    (R A B : Type u) [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B] [Algebra A B] [IsScalarTower R A B]
    (X Y Z : ModuleCat.{u} R) (d : X ⟶ Y) (q : Y ⟶ Z)
    (hexact : Function.Exact d q) (hq : Function.Surjective q)
    (hflat : Module.Flat A (A ⊗[R] Z))
    (z : X ⊗ ModuleCat.of R B) (hz : (d ▷ ModuleCat.of R B) z = 0) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (x : Fin n → X ⊗ ModuleCat.of R A) (b : Fin n → B),
      (∀ i, (d ▷ ModuleCat.of R A) (x i) = 0) ∧
      z = ∑ i, (X ◁ ModuleCat.ofHom
        ((Algebra.lsmul R R B (b i)).comp
          (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom R A B).toLinearMap)) (x i)
